name: What is included in room addition drywall and finish work?
description: It usually includes hanging drywall, taping seams, applying joint compound, sanding, and preparing the walls and ceiling for paint or texture.

mainEntity.name: What is included in room addition drywall and finish work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most room additions need drywall hanging first, then multiple finish steps: taping, mudding, sanding, and often texture matching. A clean finish depends on straight framing, proper fastener placement, and enough drying time between coats.
